timing_boundary.compatibility_label: The retained schema boundary string is a legacy compatibility label. In this adapter the launch receipt is embedded in raw-result.json and has already been written before the final measurement. The label phrase before-receipt applies only to a separate runner-receipt.json, which this adapter never emits; it must not be read as claiming the embedded receipt is written after the measurement. Actual endpoint is after hashing final raw-result bytes and before final manifest serialization.
timing_boundary.endpoint_semantics: Start existing post_start/post_cpu after confirmed child-group quiescence. End after raw-result.json is exclusively serialized and every final ordinary nonmanifest core artifact, including those final raw bytes, is identity-checked and hashed into final_inventory. Read final wall/CPU/RSS there, before final manifest/standalone-receipt serialization. The schema token is retained; raw-result is the operational companion, not a later standalone receipt.

raw_serialization.additional_post_run_checks: Only already observed predicates. The not-yet-measured final timing predicate must not be represented as observed true or false in raw.
raw_serialization.classification_scope: pre-final-inventory-and-final-measurement; final manifest owns terminal status and validity
raw_serialization.cost_boundary.excluded_finalization: Final schema validation, later fsync/race rechecks and manifest serialization/write/fsync; not included in the stated endpoint.
raw_serialization.cost_boundary.pre_raw_observation: Actual measured wall/CPU/RSS before raw serialization, labeled postflight-and-existing-file-hashing-before-raw-result-serialization; never a final substitute.
raw_serialization.cost_boundary.schema_boundary_label_sema: Legacy compatibility token; embedded raw receipt is already written, no separate receipt is emitted.
raw_serialization.launch_receipt.wrapper_postprocessing_un: The immutable raw companion precedes its own hash; authoritative final measurement is manifest.yaml#/run/resources/wrapper_postprocessing.
